dialogues.jp:
着信をバイブにしていた携帯が、机の上でブブ
ブと震えた。読んでいた雑誌を放り投げ、ベッ
ド脇の短い階段を下りる。
dialogues.en:
I could hear my cellphone vibrating on the table downstairs.
I put down the magazine I was reading and headed down.
dialogues.text:
I could hear my cellphone vibrating on the table downstairs.
I put down the magazine I was reading and headed down.

dialogues.jp: 「誰だ？　……って、登録してない人か」

ディスプレイには、番号だけが通知されている。
首を傾げつつ、俺はボタンを押した。
dialogues.en:
I didn't recognize the number shown on the display either. I
thought a little, then pressed the "Answer Call" button.
dialogues.text:
I didn't recognize the number shown on the display either. I
thought a little, then pressed the "Answer Call" button.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『あ、と、朝倉君ですか？　白河ことりです』
dialogues.en: "Ah, um, is that Asakura-kun? This is Shirakawa Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um, is that Asakura-kun? This is Shirakawa Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
思わず、携帯を握る力が強くなる。と、口を離
して、咳き込んでいるような音が受話器からも
れてきた。
dialogues.en:
I unconciously gripped the cell phone tighter. I could hear
a series of coughs from the other side.
dialogues.text:
I unconciously gripped the cell phone tighter. I could hear
a series of coughs from the other side.

dialogues.jp:
今日の昼間別れたばかりで、治るはずもないだ
ろうけど、そう｛き／訊｝かずにいられない。
dialogues.en:
Although I knew it wasn't something that would heal over an
afternoon, I asked anyway.
dialogues.text:
Although I knew it wasn't something that would heal over an
afternoon, I asked anyway.

dialogues.jp:
また、咳き込む音。やはり、体調はまだまだ悪
いらしかった。
dialogues.en:
Another series of violent coughs ensued. She won't say it
herself, but...
dialogues.text:
Another series of violent coughs ensued. She won't say it
herself, but...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや。んで？　どうしたの？」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、いや、電波が悪くなったのかなと。ん
　で？　何かな？」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, sorry, I thought my battery was running low. So what's
up?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, sorry, I thought my battery was running low. So what's
up?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりにしては、珍しく歯切れが悪い。普段は
もっと、さくさくとした口調だと思うんだけど。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was sounding oddly nervous on the phone. Normally
she'd have a far more casual tone...
dialogues.text:
Kotori was sounding oddly nervous on the phone. Normally
she'd have a far more casual tone...

dialogues.jp:
（何か言いにくいこと……？　でも、何だろう
　な？）
dialogues.en: "(Something that's hard to say...? But what could it be?)"
dialogues.text: "(Something that's hard to say...? But what could it be?)"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『えと、きょ、今日ですね、お姉ちゃんと……』
お姉ちゃん──で合点がいった。

「見舞いの件か。やっぱ、行かない方がいいか
　な？　ゆっくりと休み──」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, about my visiting. Should I really? If you need
complete rest..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, about my visiting. Should I really? If you need
complete rest..."

dialogues.jp:
耳の穴を押し広げるような大声に、思わず携帯
を遠ざけた。
dialogues.en:
I instinctively pulled the phone away from my ear, to save
my eardrums from the loud shriek that just emnated from it.
dialogues.text:
I instinctively pulled the phone away from my ear, to save
my eardrums from the loud shriek that just emnated from it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『ご、ごめんなさい、大声出して』
dialogues.en: "I, I'm sorry, I was too loud..."
dialogues.text: "I, I'm sorry, I was too loud..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「暦先生から、『明日からことりの見舞いに来
　るように』って言われて」
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei told me to visit you tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei told me to visit you tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「んで、俺はそれにうなずいたんだけど、まず
　かったかな？」
dialogues.en: "Was it okay for me to say yes to that?"
dialogues.text: "Was it okay for me to say yes to that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『ううん、そんな事ないです。きっと、来てく
　ださい』
dialogues.en: "No, it's no problem at all... please come."
dialogues.text: "No, it's no problem at all... please come."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "T, then, I'd get some rest now."
dialogues.text: "T, then, I'd get some rest now."

dialogues.jp:
手の平にはビッシリと汗が浮かんでいた。耳に
ぎゅっと押しあてていたせいで、ディスプレイ
が曇っている。
dialogues.en:
My palm was full of sweat. Having held the phone so close to
my ear, now the screen was covered with sweat too.
dialogues.text:
My palm was full of sweat. Having held the phone so close to
my ear, now the screen was covered with sweat too.

dialogues.jp:
ごしごしと、ズボンの尻に擦り付けつつ、俺は
首を傾げた。
dialogues.en:
I rubbed them against my trousers to dry them, and started
thinking.
dialogues.text:
I rubbed them against my trousers to dry them, and started
thinking.

dialogues.jp:
「……でも、ことりって電話が苦手なのかな？
　俺だって緊張してたけど、ことりの喋り方、
　いつもと違ってた気がする……」
dialogues.en:
"...Does Kotori dislike phones or something? I was more
tense than usual, but Kotori was completely different..."
dialogues.text:
"...Does Kotori dislike phones or something? I was more
tense than usual, but Kotori was completely different..."

dialogues.jp:
咳で中断されるせいで、会話の流れが掴めなかっ
ただけかもしれないけど。
dialogues.en:
I guess it was just the coughs interrupting the flow of the
conversation...
dialogues.text:
I guess it was just the coughs interrupting the flow of the
conversation...

dialogues.en: "...That's right, I should register her number."
dialogues.text: "...That's right, I should register her number."

dialogues.jp: 着信履歴で、最新の番号を呼び出す。
dialogues.en: I brought up the most recent call on my cellphone.
dialogues.text: I brought up the most recent call on my cellphone.

dialogues.jp:
携帯やＰＨＳのように、０９０や０７０で始ま
る番号じゃなかった。
dialogues.en:
Unlike cellphone numbers, this number didn't start with a
090, 080 or 070.
dialogues.text:
Unlike cellphone numbers, this number didn't start with a
090, 080 or 070.

dialogues.jp: いそいそと登録する俺であった。
dialogues.en: I quickly recorded it into my cellphone.
dialogues.text: I quickly recorded it into my cellphone.

dialogues.jp: ことりから携帯に電話が掛かってきた。

お見舞いの時間についての連絡だったのだが、
ことりの口調にいつもの歯切れがなかった。電
話が苦手なんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
As she communicated to me the time I should go there, she
wasn't her usual self. Does she dislike phones or something?
dialogues.text:
As she communicated to me the time I should go there, she
wasn't her usual self. Does she dislike phones or something?
